Name: Flame Surge
Ability: Deal 1 damage to all characters and players
Description: A shard that fell too fast and never cooled.

Name: Fire Storm
Ability: Deal 3 damage to all characters and players
Description: When three burning shards land at once, nobody claims them. Everybody runs.

Name: Whirlpool
Ability: All characters take 1 damage when this enters the field
Description: Water from one world, a drain from another. Everything nearby gets a little wet.

Name: Call Back
Ability: Return target character from a graveyard to your hand
Description: Some shards remember who held them last.
Effect: play: pick graves.character 1 hand "Pick a character from either graveyard to add to your hand."

Name: Nullify
Ability: Counter target character or spell
Description: The oldest trick a Shardkeeper learns: hold one shard against another, and both go quiet.

Name: Disable
Ability: Choose a character. That character now has no abilities
Description: It doesn't hurt. It just takes away everything that made you special.
Effect: play: target character harm, disable target

Name: Nope for One
Ability: Counter target spell which targets a single character
Description: Nope.

Name: Nope for All
Ability: Counter target spell which targets more than 1 character
Description: Nope. All of you.

Name: Return to Sender
Ability: Counter target character
Description: No, thank you. Please take it back.

Name: Try Again
Ability: Counter target spell
Description: Not this time.

Name: Mana Horder
Ability: Steal a mana from an opposing player and add it to your own maximum mana
Description: Goblins found the shards last and decided that made them first. It keeps every crumb of mana it can grab, and some it can't.

Name: Area Denial
Ability: Destroy target Area
Description: Whatever stood here, it doesn't anymore.
Effect: play: target area harm, destroyArea target

Name: Simple Farmer
Ability: When played, search your deck for a Simple Farmer and add it to your hand. Once you control 3 Simple Farmers on the field, search your deck for a Simpler Farmer and put him on the field
Description: Plants the same row every morning. Has never wondered why.
Effect: enter: fetch simple_farmer, summonFromDeck simpler_farmer if #allies.simple_farmer>=3

Name: Simple Barkeep
Ability: Add +1 health to target character
Description: Pours the same drink for everyone. Nobody has ever asked for a different one.
Effect: play: target character help, buff target 0 1

Name: Simple Swordsman
Description: Sword up. Feet planted. Simple.

Name: Simple Bowman
Description: Aims straight, because straight is the only way it knows.

Name: Simple Wanderer
Description: Walks to the edge of the village every day, looks out, and walks back.

Name: Sword
Description: Pointy end first.

Name: Bow
Ability: The character holding this has Swift
Description: Pull back. Let go. Done.

Name: Helm
Description: It doesn't fit anyone perfectly. It fits everyone well enough.

Name: Slap
Ability: Target character loses 1 Health.
Description: Rude, but effective.
Effect: play: target character harm, damage target 1+boost

Name: Simple Wizard
Ability: Choose target player or character - deal 2 damage to the target
Description: Knows exactly one spell and has never needed a second.
Effect: play: target characterOrPlayer harm, damage target 2

Name: Simple Messenger
Ability: Look at the top card of your opponent's deck - choose to place it on the top of your deck or discard it
Description: Every message it carries is short. Most of them say "All is well."

Name: Staff
Description: A walking stick, until it isn't.

Name: Herd
Ability: Add 3 Simple Farmers to the field under your control
Description: Three farmers, one field, no arguments.

Name: Simplify
Ability: Target character's stats become 1+1
Description: Whatever you were, you're a little less of it now. Simpler is better. That's what they say.
Effect: play: target character harm, setStats target 1 1

Name: Simpler Farmer
Ability: Simpler Farmer gets +1 Attack for each other Simple Farmer on the field
Description: Even simpler than the Simple Farmer. Somehow, it works better with friends.

Name: Simple Defender
Ability: Add +2 health to this character during your End Phase, and +1 health to your other Tower characters
Description: Stands at the gate every night. Has never been told what it is guarding against.

Name: Simpledom
Ability: Simple characters gain +2 in all stats
Description: A village where the sun rises at the same minute every day. The villagers like it that way.

Name: Sabre
Description: The fanciest thing in the village. It has never been used for anything fancy.

Name: Simplicity
Ability: Reduce all target player's character's stats by -2 in all categories. You gain +2 HP for each character effected
Description: Everything was fine when it was small.

Name: The Simplistic
Ability: While The Simplistic is on the field, all Simple cards can't be targeted by curse spells (buff spells still can), Simple characters and equipment get +3 to each stat, and Simple spells deal or give 3 more
Description: Everything was fine before. Everything will be fine again. Everything is fine.

Name: Fat Monkey
Description: Not lazy. Conserving energy.

Name: Smart Monkey
Description: Figured out the shards are valuable. Hasn't figured out why.

Name: Baby Monkey
Description: Small, loud, and always underfoot.

Name: Monkey Apprentice
Ability: Add a Banana from your deck to your hand. Shuffle your deck
Description: Learning the most important skill in the troop: where the bananas are.

Name: Chimp
Description: Hasn't figured out what the shards are for. Collects them anyway.

Name: Tree Branch
Ability: If there are 3 or more monkeys on the field this costs 1
Description: Every branch is a weapon if you swing it hard enough.

Name: Banana
Ability: Target character gains +1 health. Add a Peel from your deck to your hand shuffle your deck
Description: The jungle's only currency. Accepted everywhere the troop goes.
Effect: play: target character help, buff target ripen 1, fetch peel, shuffle

Name: Peel
Ability: Target character loses -1 health. If you control 3 or more monkeys it loses 2 health instead
Description: What goes up, slips down.
Effect: play: target character harm, damage target 1+#allies.Monkey>=3

Name: Jungle
Ability: All Monkey characters gain +1 attack
Description: It wasn't here last week. The troop doesn't ask questions.

Name: Orangutan
Ability: Gain +1 health for each other Monkey you control on the field
Description: Slow to anger, slower to move, impossible to move once settled.

Name: Baboon
Ability: Gain +1 attack for each character on the field
Description: The louder the room, the stronger it gets.

Name: Banana Tree
Ability: During your end phase add a Banana to your hand
Description: Grows a banana every night. The troop guards it like treasure, because it is.

Name: Ape
Description: Big. Strong. Not much more to say.

Name: Ripen
Ability: For the rest of the game Banana also adds +1 attack
Description: Give it time, and even a banana can hit back.

Name: Primate
Ability: Search your deck for 2 other Monkey characters that cost 2 or less and put them on the field
Description: When it calls, the little ones come running.

Name: Gorilla
Ability: Each time Gorilla survives damage gain +1 Attack
Description: Every hit only makes it angrier.
Effect: hurt: buff self 1 0, say self "+1 ATK" #ffe066

Name: Arboreal Intelligence
Ability: Give all Monkey character cards +5 to all stats
Description: For one brief, terrifying moment, every monkey understands everything.

Name: Call of the Jungle
Ability: Select 3 or less Monkey characters from your Graveyard return them to your hand
Description: No monkey is ever truly gone. They just went to get snacks.
Effect: play: pick grave.Monkey.character 3 hand "Pick up to 3 Monkey characters to return to your hand."

Name: Primeval Forest
Ability: All Monkey character cards have +3 to all stats
Description: The oldest trees in the jungle, though the jungle is only a week old.

Name: The Man Ape
Ability: When defending gain +10 to all stats. After each of your Battle phases you may sacrifice another Monkey you control to permanently give The Man Ape +1 to all stats and fully heal it
Description: Part man, part ape, all boss. It hoards shards like bananas, and bananas like shards.

Name: Reanimated Corpse
Description: It got back up. That's all anyone can ask.

Name: Lurker
Description: It waits. It is very good at waiting.

Name: Patched Husk
Description: Held together with string, stubbornness, and a little hope.

Name: Hungry Corpse
Ability: Gain +1 to all stats when brought from the Graveyard to the Field
Description: It was the first thing found in the wreckage, so everyone decided it was to blame.

Name: Extra Arm
Description: Not everyone's. Yours now.

Name: Haunt the Living
Ability: Target character gains Reanimate
Description: Death is just a short break.
Effect: play: target character help, grant target Reanimate

Name: Rotten Finger
Ability: Discard a card in your hand draw a card
Description: Point at what you want. It might still fall off.

Name: Rotten Hand
Ability: Discard all the cards in your hand draw 3 cards
Description: Let it all go. Something better will turn up, probably.

Name: Rise from the Dead
Ability: Return target Undead character from your graveyard to the Field
Description: Not yet.
Effect: play: pick grave.Undead.character 1 field "Pick an Undead character from your graveyard to bring back to the field."

Name: Plaguemancer
Ability: Turn target character into a Zombie and gain control of it. That character gains Reanimate
Description: It does not hate the living. It just thinks they would be happier this way.
Effect: play: target character steal, convert target reanimate

Name: Breathing Wall
Description: Every few seconds, the wall exhales. Nobody likes to lean on it.

Name: Sneaky Skinbag
Ability: During your End Phase create a Reanimated Corpse on your side of the field. Gain +1 health for each other Zombie on the field
Description: Where there's one, there are always more. It makes sure of that.

Name: Midnight Madness
Ability: Undead characters gain +2 to all stats
Description: At midnight the dead get restless, and the restless get strong.

Name: Infection
Ability: Turn target character into a Zombie and gain control of it
Description: One bite, and the argument is over.
Effect: play: target character steal, convert target

Name: Shadow-Stitched Soldier
Ability: After returning from the Graveyard to the Field Evolve
Description: Stitched from the shadows of a dozen soldiers. Each time it falls, it comes back with a little more of them.

Name: Zombombadier
Ability: Deal damage to all characters and players equal to this Zombombadier's stat line. After returning from the Graveyard to the Field Evolve
Description: Handle with care. Then run.

Name: Soul Suction
Ability: Destroy target character gain HP based on that character's stat-line
Description: Everything a soul was, poured into something else.
Effect: play: target character harm, drainLife target, damage target 99999

Name: They Just Keep Coming
Ability: This costs 1 less for each Zombie on the field. Every Zombie gains Reanimate. If a Zombie already has Reanimate give them +3 health
Description: You can win every fight and still lose the war.

Name: Death's Grasp
Ability: Destroy target character. Ignore skills and abilities
Description: No tricks. No second chances. Just the end.
Effect: play: target character harm, destroy target

Name: Soul Shepard
Ability: Each time another Undead character is sent to your graveyard, choose: gain its stats as they read, or return it to your hand. This card also gets +1 Health each time an Undead character dies, on either side, counted from the start of the match wherever it is
Description: It gathers the fallen from every world, and never asks whose fault it was.

Name: Seasoned Monk
Description: Has trained every day for forty years. Still calls it practice.

Name: White Belt Student
Ability: Level Up whenever an equipment enters the Field. After Level Up is triggered 3 times Transform into Black Belt Student. Keep stats from Level Up
Description: Day one. Every master had one.
Effect: gearEnters: levelUp self 1; maxLevel: transform self black_belt_student

Name: Weapons Enthusiast
Ability: Equip costs become 1 when equipping to Weapons Enthusiast
Description: Has opinions about every weapon ever made, and will share them.

Name: Sensei
Ability: While Sensei is on the field all equip costs become 0, and your Students get +1 to all stats
Description: The best teachers make it look easy, so their students never notice how hard it was.

Name: Sparring Gear
Description: Padding for the body. Nothing for the pride.

Name: Zippy Shoes
Ability: The character holding this has Swift
Description: Fast feet, faster fists.

Name: McKnuckle Dusters
Description: For when politeness has run out.

Name: Bite the Ear
Ability: Target character loses 1 health
Description: Not in any rulebook. Works anyway.
Effect: play: target character harm, damage target 1

Name: Sweep the Leg
Ability: Target character loses Swift and 1 Attack
Description: Balance is everything. Take it away, and nothing is left.
Effect: play: target character harm, removeSkill target Swift, loseAttack target 1

Name: Black Belt Student
Ability: Transform into 5th Degree Master after surviving 3 combat phases
Description: Knows every move. Now it must learn when to use them.

Name: Fight Choreographer
Ability: Each other Fighter character on the field gains +2 to all stats
Description: Every punch is a step in a dance. It knows all the steps.

Name: Nunchucks
Ability: Can be equipped anytime as long as you have the mana
Description: Hard to master. Easy to bonk yourself with.

Name: Bo Staff
Ability: Can be equipped anytime as long as you have the mana
Description: Long reach, longer tradition.

Name: Dojo
Ability: Each Fighter character gains Parry and +2 to all stats
Description: Respect the floor, and it will respect you.
Effect: aura: buff allies.Fighter 2 2, grant allies.Fighter Parry

Name: 5th Degree Master
Ability: Your Student Fighters have Parry
Description: It has nothing left to prove, and still trains every morning.

Name: Master Rat
Ability: Summon 4 1+1 turtles who each have Gain +1 to each stat for every other turtle on the field
Description: Old, wise, and very fond of its four students. They are all turtles, and nobody has asked why.

Name: Crane Kick
Ability: Target character loses 7 health
Description: If done right, it can't be blocked.
Effect: play: target character harm, damage target 7

Name: Shaolin Warrior
Ability: Each character and equipment on the field makes this card cost 1 less
Description: Born of a lifetime of training. It only steps in when the whole world is watching.

Name: Kenshi's Blade
Ability: Once per Battle Phase on your turn choose to deal 3 damage to target character
Description: Kenshi never missed. The blade remembers.
Effect: play: target character.enemy harm, damage target 3; rule: strike

Name: IP Man
Ability: Once per turn the first damage that would be dealt to you or IP Man goes to an enemy character or player of your choice instead
Description: Calm, polite, and unbeatable. He bows before every fight and expects a bow back.
Effect: play: target characterOrPlayer.enemy harm, damage target amount; rule: redirect

Name: Noob
Description: Level 1. Everyone starts somewhere.

Name: Glitch
Description: There for a frame, gone the next. Some say it was here before the break.

Name: Spam Bot
Ability: Trigger target character's Level Up
Description: You have 1 new message. You have 1 new message. You have 1 new message.
Effect: play: target character.leveler help, levelUp target 1

Name: Gaming Headset
Description: Hears everything. Mostly people yelling.

Name: Speedrunner
Ability: Gets +1 attack for each other Swift character you control
Description: Has finished this fight faster in practice.

Name: Beta Tester
Ability: Levels Up during your End Phase
Description: Finds every bug, reports none of them.

Name: Upgrade
Ability: Trigger target character's Level Up
Description: New and improved. Mostly new.
Effect: play: target character.leveler help, levelUp target 1

Name: Digital Girlfriend
Ability: Trigger target character's Level Up
Description: Always online. Always supportive. Never asks about the shards.
Effect: play: target character.leveler help, levelUp target 1

Name: Catfish
Ability: Target character loses -1 to all stats
Description: Looked a lot better in the picture.
Effect: play: target character harm, shrink target 1

Name: Secure the Data
Ability: Target character gains Cloak until the start of your next turn
Description: Behind three firewalls, two passwords, and one very tired admin.
Effect: play: target character help, grant target Cloak temp, say target SECURED #6fe3ff

Name: Pro Gamer
Ability: Levels Up each time it attacks
Description: Gets better every time it attacks. Mostly at trash talk.

Name: Pesky Programmer
Ability: When this character Levels Up it gains +2 Attack but +0 Health
Description: It works on its machine.

Name: Hacker
Description: Already inside.

Name: Gymfluencer
Ability: Trigger target character's Level Up twice
Description: Doesn't train you. Just posts about it until you level up.
Effect: play: target character.leveler help, levelUp target 2

Name: API Key
Ability: This character gains Level Up. The character holding this Levels Up during your End Phase
Description: The key to everything. Don't share it.
Effect: endTurn: levelUp holder 1; rule: teach "Level Up"

Name: Overclocker
Description: Pushed far past what it was built for. It runs hot. It runs fast. It does not run for long.

Name: Data Collector
Ability: When your other characters Level Up Data Collector gains +1 Health
Description: It has been collecting since long before the worlds collided. It never says for whom.
Effect: allyLevelUp: grow self 1, say self "+1 HP" #6fe3ff

Name: Server Farm
Ability: Your characters Level Up during your End Phase
Description: Rows and rows of humming racks. From above, they look a lot like turnip fields.

Name: Data Transfer
Ability: Once during each of your Setup phases you may remove a Level from one of your characters to gain 2 HP. During your End Phase your strongest Level Up character Levels Up
Description: Moving a level from here to there. Nothing is lost. Nothing is ever really lost.
Effect: play: target character.mine.levels help, script dataTransfer; endTurn: levelUp allies.leveler.strongest 1; rule: activate

Name: Digital Drainage
Ability: Your Level Up characters Level Up 3 times. Each opposing character loses Attack equal to the number of Levels of your highest-Attack Level Up character
Description: Every level gained is a level someone else lost.

Name: Boss Level
Ability: This character has no limit to Level Up
Description: Every world needs a final boss. Boss Level made sure of it.
